[EN] What just happened? I couldn't see anything...
[ES] ¿Qué acaba de pasar? No pude ver nada...

[EN] It seems that Amber Essence makes these things crazy.
[ES] Parece que la Esencia ámbar vuelve locas a estas cosas.

[EN] They're probably very confused.
[ES] Probablemente están muy confundidos.

[EN] I think we have company. We should split up.
[ES] Creo que tenemos compañía. Deberíamos separarnos.
